title: Turning tracking off on a part with stock asks for no confirmation
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab at {Location-A}.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in, and bin {Bin-B} is a second bin at {Location-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BIN-B).
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOCONF-01) is active and tracked at {Location-A}, with 4 in {Bin-A} and 3 in {Bin-B} (7 on hand).
custom_steps:
1. Search the part number of {Part-A} and click its row.
  2. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch so it is off.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Read the {Part-A} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The switch turns off at once. No confirmation, warning or message appears, even though the part holds 7.
  • Step 3: The dialog closes straight away; no confirmation dialog of any kind opens.
  • Step 4: The row reads "Not Tracked" in Total Qty.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S5-R5, S5-R1 and §4 Key Decisions (Turning tracking off only hides the count), read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 5.2 (Switch off) and tracking-note-1, 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R5: “Turning tracking off asks for no confirmation, whatever the part holds.”
  • S5-R1: “The "Track quantities and cost of goods" switch can be changed in the Edit Inventory Part dialog.”
  • PRD §4 Key Decisions: “Turning tracking off only hides the count. Nothing is cleared and nothing is written off, so there is nothing to confirm.”
